shareRule.note: Decided (ops decision D40 item 7): what a category receives for the month, so far as it does not go to a named active recipient, goes in equal shares to every active listed recipient of the category, apportioned by largest remainder with ties broken by the order of this list (ascending recipientId), so the shares sum exactly to the category's amount. An organisation removed at once under statutes Art. 7(6) has no share from then on, and its share for that month goes to the other active recipients of its category, except after a sanctions hit.
